description: Painted sprite for the rebel rook (?art=paint): one whole image, eyes painted in. Step 1 paints a full-body game pose from the reference crop, the style sheet and the SVG rig's pose; step 2 removes the background. Then tools/art/sprite.mjs trims it, thickens the outer outline and writes src/assets/sprites/rebel-rook.webp.

steps.name: pose
steps.prompt: Full-body game sprite, painted as one single whole image, of the stonemason ROOK from the first image, painted in the art style of the second image (a character select sheet). Use the third image only for the full-body pose and chunky proportions, not for its style. SUBJECT: a huge scrappy rebel stonemason. A grey stone castle-tower great-helm with an overhanging band of three square battlements on top, and a T-shaped eye opening that is a solid black void showing only two small cream dot eyes. Bare muscular arms, a patched brown-and-green sleeveless tunic with ragged hem, a big red bandana knotted round his neck whose points hang down over his chest, a leather wrist wrap, short brown boots. A big stone sledgehammer held upright in his right fist on the right side of the figure: a compact chipped grey stone block head no wider than a third of the helm, on a long straight wooden handle. The bare skin fist clearly wraps around the handle about a third of the way up from its bottom end, the handle rises straight up above the fist so the stone head sits beside the top of the helm, and the handle's butt end shows below the fist. His left arm hangs relaxed at his left side with a closed fist; neither arm crosses his chest, so the whole red bandana is visible. Standing, three-quarter view facing right, feet visible, chunky and big-headed: the tower helm is about half the figure's height. Bold simple shapes with few interior lines: flat colour areas, no fine muscle hatching. EYES: the two small cream dot eyes are painted inside the black T-shaped opening, side by side, level, clearly visible. POSE: a natural, anatomically correct pose. Each arm hangs from its own shoulder, the elbows bend the natural way and the hands sit at the ends of the arms; nothing is backwards, reversed or twisted. The weapon is gripped firmly in the front fist with the fingers wrapped round it, never floating. SILHOUETTE: one clean, readable silhouette with simple chunky shapes and few interior lines, nothing thin dangling off it. A VERY thick black outer outline runs all the way round the whole silhouette, about twice as thick as the inner lines, so the figure reads clearly at 48 pixels tall. STYLE to match the second image exactly: bold flash-era 2D brawler cartoon, very thick even black outlines, flat fills, one hard cel shadow, crisp white highlights, earthy colours with the red bandana as the one bright accent. One character only, centred, on a plain flat light grey background (#d8d8d8), no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no frame.
